q: Which payment methods are growing fastest this month compared to last month? Show percentage growth.
sql: SELECT payment_method, COALESCE(((SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(transaction_date AS DATE)) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE()) THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(transaction_date AS DATE)) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL '1 month') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)) - 1) * 100, 0) AS growth_percentage FROM silver_transactions WHERE CAST(transaction_date AS DATE) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL '2 months') AND CAST(transaction_date AS DATE) < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE()) + INTERVAL '1 month' AND payment_method IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND quality_flag = 'PASS' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC;

q: Which 5 merchants have the highest refund rate? Show refund count and total transaction count.
sql: SELECT m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN st.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 END) AS refund_count, COUNT(st.transaction_id) AS total_transaction_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN st.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(st.transaction_id), 0) AS refund_rate FROM merchants m JOIN (SELECT merchant_id, transaction_id, status FROM silver_transactions WHERE quality_flag = 'PASS' AND transaction_date::DATE >= date_trunc('day', current_date) - interval '1 year' AND status IS NOT NULL AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL) st ON m.merchant_id = st.merchant_id GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 5;
